title: [Safety] Stopping insulin delivery logs carbs which then triggers delivery
symptom: When a user cancels a bolus after entering carbs, the carbs are logged even though no insulin was delivered, which can lead to double dosing if the user re-enters carbs and boluses again.
cause: In the version reported (v3.0.0.2 dev-k), carbs were logged even when the bolus was cancelled before delivery.
fix: The maintainer states that in the current version, carbs are not logged if the bolus is not successful, implying the issue has been fixed.
evidence_quote: in current version carbs are not logged if bolus is not successful (in oposition to previous versions)
